prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin across all kinds of changes, as no kind of change has at least 2 tests yet to establish a pattern.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- sign_in, reorder: +2.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pet preview confirmation screen: Insert a dedicated pet preview approval screen right before generating the adoption certificate. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pets failing or looking wrong upon adoption completion.)
1: [choose_path, reorder] Story scroll visual introduction: Reorder the story screen layout to a story_scroll format to engage users before selecting a path. (why: Choose path takes a long mean time of 514s and drops 23.8% of users.)
2: [home, new_flow] Interactive waiting room with tips: Transform the waiting screen into an interactive room featuring progress tracking and helpful tip carousels. (why: Waiting during setup has a mean duration of 2336s and 3 support tickets noted pets not opening or appearing.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing account sync hint: Display explicit account sync reassurance copy under the sign-in options. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing back in.)
4: [home, wait_info] Generation progress time notice: Show estimated processing time and notification option on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting takes median 201s and mean 2336s, causing uncertainty if the app stalls.)
5: [adoption, layout] Grid view for pet picker: Switch the pet selection screen to a multi-column grid layout for faster visual browsing. (why: Adoption step takes median 89s and drops nearly 40% of users.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop visibility assurance headline: Update final screen text with clear instructions on where the pet resides on the desktop. (why: 3 support tickets mentioned pets not showing up on the desktop after onboarding.)
7: [sign_in, notification] Sign-in troubleshooting tip carousel: Add a tip carousel on the sign-in screen explaining account recovery and sign-in help. (why: 2 emails reported sign-in stalling and 8 emails reported missing pets after signing in.)
